After returning from war, he embarked on a beautiful 72-year marriage with Janet Kajano, a woman who transformed his life. They raised four children together, creating a rich tapestry of community involvement and travel.
title: WWII veteran, 101, recalls wife who helped him rebuild life, 72-year marriage

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a bold warning to the U.S., China has reacted to Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia, citing concerns over alleged espionage connections. His departure could trigger stringent export restrictions on technology, escalating tensions in trade relations. Analysts point to rising hawkish attitudes in Washington, with Chinese tech stocks already sliding as the fallout from this scandal unfolds, highlighting the fragile nature of U.S.-China economic ties.
title: China warns US over Jensen Huang’s relationship, says stop ‘fabricating’ spy claims

description: After a tough defeat to New Zealand in the fourth ODI, Virat Kohli showcased remarkable sportsmanship by gifting a jersey to pacer Matt Henry, who excelled with impressive bowling figures of 6/27. Despite India's struggles at the crease, Will Young's century propelled New Zealand to a total of 333 runs. Fortunately, India still maintains a 2-1 lead in the five-match ODI series with one game left to play.
title: Kohli's special gesture for Matt Henry goes viral after NZ pacer's 6-wicket haul

description: A consumer complaint was filed by Hardik Shah against Ola over forgotten car keys left in a cab. After several attempts to contact the driver, the keys were returned without charge on June 19. The commission found no evidence of deficiency in service or unfair trade practices by Ola. Dissatisfaction with generic email responses does not constitute grounds for complaint dismissal.
title: Mumbai man loses car keys in ₹330 Ola ride, driver returns them for free

description: Kaja Kallas, the European foreign policy chief, has underscored the necessity of establishing a ceasefire in Ukraine. She cautioned that upcoming peace talks should not divert attention towards addressing Russia’s security demands. Kallas voiced her apprehension over potentially falling for Russia’s tactical manipulations. Meanwhile, US special envoy Steve Witkoff mentioned that European representatives would continue in the negotiation process.
title: 'Must not fall into Russia's trap': EU's Kallas warns Europe over Ukraine peace talks

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Poland aims to make the American military presence permanent, currently hosting around 10,000 American troops. Polish officials plan to accommodate an additional 5,000 personnel through permanent infrastructure development. The investment for this infrastructure is estimated between 15 billion and 17 billion zlotys. Proposed locations for new installations include Bydgoszcz, Poznań, Szczecin, and Wrocław. A permanent deployment would enhance deterrence against potential Russian aggression and improve military coordination.
title: Poland gets Pentagon green light for permanent US base near Russia; 5,000 troops planned

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a hilarious turn of events, a raccoon broke into a Virginia liquor store last November, delighted in a drinking spree, and ended up napping in the bathroom. This escapade quickly became an internet hit, prompting the creation of themed merchandise that raised over $290,000 for the Hanover County shelter. The 'Trashed Panda' has become a mascot of support for the shelter's growth efforts.
title: Drunk raccoon's liquor store break-in raises $290,000 for animal shelter

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Constance Milstein has initiated legal action against her brother and daughters over trust payments that she alleges have been cut off. Seeking restitution for her stopped monthly distributions of $125,000, she asserts her financial need. However, her family disputes her claims, arguing the trust serves her children better, while lawyers suggest her lavish spending implies she's not truly in financial distress.
title: NY heiress, 80, alleges family cut off $125,000 monthly trust payments

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
description: Maharashtra authorities have taken action by seizing beauty creams in Nanded that contained alarmingly high levels of mercury, valued at Rs 40 lakh. Laboratory analysis revealed that these creams posed severe health risks due to toxic contents beyond acceptable limits. Officials have issued a public alert against usage, and a legal case under drug safety regulations has been filed.
title: Pak beauty cream seized in Maharashtra found with mercury 48,000 times over limit

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The new Yesvantpur-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express has been introduced to improve rail connectivity between Bengaluru, coastal Karnataka and Goa. The service will provide direct access to several key stations, including Hassan, Sakleshpur, Subrahmanya Road, Mangaluru, Udupi, Kundapura, Murdeshwar, Gokarna and Karwar.
title: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express launched: Check schedule, stoppages

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Stand-in captain Shreyas Iyer acknowledged the impact of New Zealand’s bowling, particularly Matt Henry's six-wicket haul. India collapsed to just 89 runs while chasing a target of 334 after New Zealand posted 333 in their innings. Iyer emphasized that the Indian batters were dismissed by quality deliveries rather than poor performance. He urged the team to learn from the experience and remain confident from earlier victories.
title: 'No one threw their wicket away': Iyer's blunt response after 244-run defeat

author: MUKUT DAS
description: A devastating collision occurred Friday afternoon near Kaziranga, involving a mini-bus with around 40 passengers that crashed head-on with a trailer truck. Reports from cabinet minister Atul Bora indicate that at least 20 people are feared dead. The mini-bus was en route from Jorhat to Guwahati. Injured individuals were transported to Kohora Model Hospital, with 13 requiring further treatment at Jorhat Medical College.
title: At least 20 feared dead as minibus collides with trailer truck near Assam's Kaziranga

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft 365 outage update: Microsoft says Outlook, Teams and other services are seeing 'incremental improvement' as phased recovery continues, more than 16 hours after the outage began on November 12. However, the company says service health remains variable and has not shared a timeline for full restoration. The Microsoft outage has disrupted airlines in India, including IndiGo and Akasa Air, along with governments and businesses worldwide.
title: More than 16 hours after global outage, Microsoft still struggling to fix issue

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India suffered a significant loss in the fourth ODI, bowled out for just 89 runs while chasing 334 runs. New Zealand's Matt Henry took six wickets, leading to India's second biggest loss by runs in ODI history. Will Young scored a century for New Zealand, contributing to their total of 334.
title: India suffer second-biggest ODI defeat; lose fourth ODI to NZ by 244 runs

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Mahli Beardman made a remarkable entry into One Day Internationals, claiming six wickets in his debut match against England in Perth. Australia effectively chased down England's target of 131 runs, thanks in part to a brisk fifty from captain Mitch Marsh. This triumph secured a 1-0 lead for Australia in the ODI series, with the second match awaited in Adelaide this coming Sunday.
title: 6/24 on debut! Mahli Beardman rips through England as Australia take 1-0 lead

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: India's export growth shot up by almost 30 percent year-on-year, reaching close to $90 billion in October 2026. Merchandise exports accounted for a significant $49.47 billion, marking a record high for monthly goods. Though imports also climbed, resulting in a trade deficit of $39.88 billion, the services sector helped mitigate this, supported by recent trade agreements with the UK, New Zealand, and forthcoming EU discussions.
title: India's exports jump 29.9% to $89.99 billion in October; overall trade deficit narrows

title: 'No NCP merger talks': Maharashtra minister Bharne after meeting Sunetra Pawar

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: In a strongly worded communication to IOA president PT Usha on her complaints, the world body has called for elections to be conducted in strict compliance with the Olympic Charter and IOA Constitution, in a “free and fair manner and without any external interference”.
title: ‘Very disappointed’: IOC backs call for clean IOA elections after PT Usha flags irregularities

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Reservations are open starting today at authorised dealerships and online, with a Rs 10 lakh deposit for either model. Buyers get a home charger with installation, and six years of roadside assistance. The warranty covers six years or 1.5 lakh km, while the battery is covered for eight years or 1.6 lakh km.
title: DENZA enters India with Z9 GT and D9 priced from Rs 90 lakh

author: YUDHVIR RANA
description: Amritpal Singh, MP from Khadoor Sahib, has been granted one-day interim bail by a local court. This bail allows him to attend the cremation of his grandmother, Charan Kaur, who recently passed away. His uncle, Harjeet Singh, and a relative, Sukhman Singh, received three and two days' bail, respectively. The exact time of Amritpal's arrival in Amritsar or flight details are still not confirmed.
title: Amritpal Singh gets 1-day interim bail to attend grandmother's last rites

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Yes' iconic album 'Fragile' cover painting was returned to its creator Roger Dean after being missing for nearly 50 years. Art Recovery International successfully negotiated the painting's return following a suspicious claim by a collector. The original artwork will be auctioned on December 2, 2026, with an estimated value of £75,000. Dean noted that he recognized the painting, despite noticing some changes over the years.
title: Yes album cover missing for decades returns to artist, heads to £75,000 auction

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An Indiana appeals court has upheld the removal of Rebecca Johnson as co-administrator of Shane Fields' estate after disputes over estate management and legal representation. Fields died in a 2025 Kentucky road accident, leaving a wife and five children. The court found that Johnson's refusal to follow court orders and cooperate with the other representative delayed the estate's legal claims. His daughter, Hailey Daniels, will remain the sole administrator.
title: Indiana worker dies in crash; court backs daughter to manage estate over widow

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Joseph Makhani has been sentenced to seven to 21 years in prison for using forged documents to steal two Harlem brownstones worth $4.7 million. His scheme left an elderly homeowner living in a homeless shelter while he collected more than $12,000 in monthly rent from one of the properties.
title: NY fraudster steals $4.7m in Harlem homes; gets up to 21 years in prison

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Paytm's payment segment has secured initial approval from the Reserve Bank of India for its prepaid payment instruments. This milestone has propelled One 97 Communications' stock to soar past the Rs 1,900 mark, reflecting strong market performance. Analysts predict robust revenue growth stemming from the enhanced merchant discount rate framework for UPI transactions, with global brokerage Bernstein naming Paytm as a leading growth prospect in finance.
title: Paytm gets RBI prelim nod to operate wallets; shares surge to 52-week high

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI

title: Beardman does what McGrath, Starc couldn't; unleashes pace storm to make history

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Louisiana appeals court has upheld a legal agreement requiring a divorced husband to keep paying his ex-wife's expenses. The court ruled these payments represent contractual duties rather than typical spousal support subject to change upon remarriage. Previous agreements concerning property and payments have been recognized, and the validity of the house deed has been affirmed. Both parties will bear the appeal costs, and either party can seek a rehearing.
title: Louisiana man must pay ex-wife's fuel and health insurance after her remarriage

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: New York City has prohibited surveillance pricing, a practice where companies charge different prices to customers. The legislation received overwhelming support from the City Council, passing with a 44-5 vote. Sponsored by Speaker Julie Menin, the bill addresses companies' use of personal data for price discrimination. Violations of the law will incur a fine of $1,000 for non-compliant companies.
title: Zohran Mamdani’s NYC bans Uber, Target from using personal data to set prices

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft says it is seeing 'positive results' in fixing the global Microsoft 365 outage that knocked Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Copilot offline for millions. The company applied an authentication and routing patch to part of its infrastructure and said there is no sign of a cyberattack. The outage disrupted airlines including IndiGo and Akasa Air, AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic, and governments worldwide. Full restoration has no ETA yet.
title: Microsoft outage: Company issues update as services face global disruption

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Gautam Gambhir raised alarms regarding India's batting inadequacies following a heavy loss to New Zealand. With India crumbling to just 89 runs in pursuit of 334, Matt Henry's impressive six-wicket haul underscored their struggle against quality seam bowling. Gambhir noted the critical need for the team to adjust to tough playing conditions, highlighting ongoing batting failures. The upcoming fifth ODI will decide the series, currently led by India 2-1.
title: 'No unplayable deliveries': Gambhir raises 'concern' after India's horror show

description: In a tragic incident in Ahmedabad, a young motorcyclist named Pradeep Darwal lost his life when a speeding Range Rover struck him near Shilaj Circle. Prompt action by law enforcement led to the arrest of Raghavendra Kushwaha, the driver related to a local MLA. Despite fleeing after the crash and the police recovering the vehicle, Kushwaha was released on bail.
title: Ahmedabad hit-and-run: BJP MLA's nephew arrested after Range Rover kills man

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Bharigu Sharma took action against Oceanic Gym due to premature closures and unfulfilled promises regarding hygiene and facilities. After presenting his case, the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission sided with him, mandating both a refund and additional compensation. The gym was deemed negligent in upholding its advertised standards, with a stipulated deadline set for compliance with the commission's ruling.
title: Paid Rs 5,760 for gym membership, quit in 2 months; Amritsar man wins Rs 6,500

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Oil marketing companies are currently facing losses on petrol and diesel sales, although these losses have recently decreased. Marketing losses on petrol have fallen to Rs 12 per litre and Rs 27 per litre for diesel. A decline in the Indian crude basket price has contributed to this improvement. Global crude supply conditions have improved significantly, but elevated freight rates still pose challenges.
title: OMCs continue to face petrol, diesel losses despite easing crude prices: Jefferies

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The case concerns a man’s income tax return for assessment year 2025-26. The taxpayer had opted for the new income tax regime in the preceding assessment year, 2024-25. On August 31, 2025, when he filed Form 10-IEA he opted out of the new regime and was taxed under the old income regime.
title: Taxpayer faces Rs 1.41 lakh demand over tax regime error; why ITAT ruled for old

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Grammy-winning DJ and producer Zedd has sold his Hollywood Hills home for $4.25 million recently. The four-bedroom house was listed initially for $5.5 million in October 2025 after several price reductions. The buyers, fans of Zedd, plan to convert his recording studio into a cinema space. Zedd had owned the property for over a decade after purchasing it for $3.9 million in 2014.
title: DJ Zedd's $3.9m Hollywood home sells for $4.25m to fans eyeing studio cinema

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a significant development, consumers in 43 US states will receive a total of $183.5 million in refunds and debt relief from Acima Digital, following allegations of deceptive advertising linked to rental-purchase agreements. This settlement promises automatic restitution and lease forgiveness for those affected, alongside a commitment from Acima to improve their advertising transparency, pending court approval in Pennsylvania.
title: US rent-to-own customers could get refunds in proposed $183.5m settlement

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Indian Army will initiate field trials for indigenous jet-powered kamikaze drones at Pokhran. This program represents an investment of approximately Rs 2,000 crore, indicating a significant military advancement. A total of 540 units are planned for acquisition under the Fast Track Procurement scheme. Various Indian companies are competing to demonstrate their capabilities in these unmanned systems. Successful trials of these drones could enhance India's military capabilities significantly.
title: Three times faster, harder to intercept: Army sets sights on 540 jet-powered kamikaze drones

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India has invited Pakistan to participate in the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. This event is scheduled to take place from November 20 to 22, featuring various participating countries. Union culture minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat expressed hope that Pakistan would attend the forum. The discussions will focus on cultural ties and shared civilisational heritage among member states.
title: 'Hopeful they will come': India on inviting Pak to SCO Civilisational Forum in Delhi

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In October, Russia significantly increased its diesel exports following an agreement between Trump and Putin aimed at boosting global supplies. However, U.S. markets have not seen any additional shipments due to concerns over sanctions and buyer reluctance. Most of the diesel was redirected to Brazil and Turkey instead. Experts warn that ongoing challenges at Russian refineries and potential renewed assaults may hinder future export levels.

description: A federal court in Kentucky ordered ICE to release Cuban national Damichel Jesus Viamontes Castellano after finding that authorities had detained him for nearly six months without following mandatory custody review and notice procedures.

description: Matt Henry once again tormented India, producing a sensational six-wicket haul to trigger memories of the 2019 World Cup semifinal. One staffer's companywide email called for transparency, while the board has named CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO and former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones as chair.

description: The US Navy is set to redefine its attack submarine capabilities with the next-generation SSN(X). This submarine will function as a launch platform for unmanned systems while improving speed and reducing maintenance time. Additionally, India is advancing its own unmanned maritime capabilities through recent innovations and systems development. Challenges include managing operational requirements in rough coastal conditions and ensuring effective communication across platforms.
title: US plans to turn submarines into drone motherships: How India is charting its own course

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: IIT Bombay has launched an innovative project aimed at turning garden waste, such as fallen leaves, into eco-friendly cooking fuel pellets. These pellets not only substitute LPG for feeding approximately 1,200 students but also utilize a downdraft gasifier to extract producer gas from biomass. By adopting this initiative, the institution saves nearly Rs 50 lakh annually on waste disposal while advancing sustainable energy practices on campus.
title: IIT Bombay turns fallen leaves into cooking fuel, cuts hostel LPG use by 60%

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: ESA's Hera spacecraft has initiated its observations of the Didymos asteroid system following NASA's DART mission's collision with Dimorphos. This investigation seeks to analyze the impact's effects on Dimorphos' structure and its trajectory, which is essential for planetary defense. Researchers aim to uncover the momentum enhancement factor and physical effects of the collision, while also deploying CubeSats for comprehensive data collection on both asteroids.
title: Nasa asteroid crash site reached by European probe to assess deflection

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The project is estimated to cost Rs 8,571 crore. The proposed facility at Chandikhol will have the capacity to hold four million tonnes (MT) of crude oil, expanding the country’s existing strategic storage capacity by 80%. The government is offering financial support of up to Rs 5,142 crore for the project. According to the tender documents, the contract will go to the bidder that seeks the lowest grant.
title: India to build its largest oil reserve at Rs 8,571 crore amid Hormuz crisis

description: In Ohio, the unexpected death of Eleanor M. Hovanick has led to a court ruling that the proceeds from her farm sale must go to her heirs as stipulated in her will. Despite having established a transfer-on-death deed for beneficiaries, the binding sale contract transformed her stake into a right to payment, altering the inheritance process.
title: Ohio woman dies after selling 62-acre farm for $350,000; court decides heirs

description: India's recent ODI match against New Zealand marked a significant collapse, resembling their 1983 World Cup fiasco. After losing three wickets for zero runs, India's situation deteriorated rapidly as they trailed behind the target of 334 runs. Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli both recorded ducks simultaneously for the second time in their careers. This incident echoed previous historical instances for the Indian cricket team, raising concerns among fans.

description: A remarkable Queenslander residence located in Newmarket, Brisbane, was sold for A$4.9 million following an auction. The buyer, who has local roots, had no intention of bidding initially but ultimately decided to secure the property. This six-bedroom home, featuring expansive views of the city, marks a significant sale in a currently sluggish property market influenced by rising interest rates and borrowing challenges.
title: Brisbane man buys childhood neighbour's 1920s home for A$4.9m at auction

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: For over two decades, Jim and Laura Currie have passionately worked to rejuvenate their land in Mississippi, joining forces with organizations to safeguard the endangered dusky gopher frog. In June 2026, they proudly launched a project, releasing almost 500 captive-bred frogs onto their revitalized property, with ongoing monitoring set to ensure these frogs flourish in their new home.
title: Couple restores Mississippi land for 20 years; nearly 500 rare frogs released

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Olivia Wilde's collaboration with Artists for Peace and Justice is pivotal in revolutionizing educational access for Haitian children. Following the devastating earthquake in 2010, the organization launched a free school in Port-au-Prince and now assists over 1,400 students each year. Despite ongoing gang violence hindering educational efforts, recent fundraising initiatives have generated substantial support, underscoring the vital need for continued investment in children's education and healthcare in Haiti.
title: Olivia Wilde-backed Haiti school charity has helped over 32,000 children

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Bearadise in Orange Park has evolved from a simple display into a beloved Halloween destination over the years. Crafted by Matt McCary, this immersive attraction features a graveyard, eerie tombstones, and haunting sound effects. With a nod to history, QR codes reveal insights about the Salem witch trials, ensuring an educational twist. This community-driven experience attracts around 250 trick-or-treaters annually, solidifying its status as a cherished neighborhood tradition.
title: Florida man's Halloween display grows from hay bales to 5,000 sq ft in 7 years

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: In the fourth ODI against New Zealand, India faced a catastrophic start to their innings. Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Shreyas Iyer were dismissed by Matt Henry in the opening over. Rohit fell to a golden duck, followed by Kohli and Iyer, who were also dismissed without scoring. This marked only the second instance of Sharma and Kohli both scoring ducks in the same ODI.
title: Rohit, Kohli, Iyer fall for ducks; India suffer first-ever 0/3 start in ODIs

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A legal clash continues between Alabama Power and landowner Fenn Church over a transmission line easement. Alabama Power has appealed to the state Supreme Court after a judge refused its request for a temporary restraining order. Church is disputing the compensation for the easement while contesting the company's access to his property, as the work to construct a 74-mile transmission line faces potential delays threatening its May 2027 completion.

description: Microsoft faced a significant outage that disrupted key services like Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive, affecting users globally. Many struggled to connect with crucial workplace tools, leading to mixed reactions online, from humorous memes to speculations about cyberattacks. Although Microsoft has not linked the outage to any cybersecurity threats, the incident sparked widespread chatter across social media, giving a brief pause in the work routine.

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Rahul Gandhi has renewed his challenge for a public debate with Prime Minister Narendra Modi during an Instagram session. He claimed he was unable to speak freely in Parliament and called for direct allegations against each other. Gandhi suggested a debate moderated by a neutral party, including options like RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat. BJP leaders dismissed his calls, emphasizing that Parliament serves as an appropriate platform for discussions.
title: 'No long speeches': Rahul renews debate challenge to PM Modi with a 'guarantee'

author: TNN
description: Raj Kumar, a 44-year-old stock market investor, was arrested for murdering Anitha Arun Kumar at her flat. Anitha was found dead at home after her children returned from school without her. The suspect reportedly committed the crime due to financial issues amounting to four crore rupees in debt. Evidence, including CCTV footage, led the police to identify Raj as the assailant.
title: How debt-ridden stock market investor killed top executive's wife

author: SANJAY SHARMA
description: Archaeologists have discovered 154 figurative clay artefacts dating back 15,000 to 11,650 years at three prehistoric sites in Israel, challenging the belief that clay art emerged alongside farming. Published in PLOS ONE on November 11, 2026, the study also reveals fingerprints belonging to children, adolescents and adults. Some impressions suggest children younger than 10 helped shape the figurines alongside adults, offering rare evidence of prehistoric childhood, creative learning and artistic traditions among ancient hunter-gatherer communities.
title: 15,000-year-old figurines suggest children were creating art too

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Chris Van Hollen has declared his intention to run for the Senate Majority Leader position against Chuck Schumer. He argues that the Democratic Party needs new leadership to better address voter desires for change. Support for Van Hollen's bid has come from influential figures like Bernie Sanders and Abdul El-Sayed. Meanwhile, Schumer maintains his confidence in retaining his leadership role amid ongoing discussions.

description: In a surprising revelation, veteran actor Paresh Rawal disclosed an unusual leg injury recovery method he tried. description: Redditch Borough Council's innovative plan to use waste heat from a crematorium to warm a swimming pool is gaining traction. This project has generated significant discussions and recognition for its environmental benefits since 2013. Similar initiatives are emerging in Scotland and Finland, aiming to utilize crematoriums for heating schools and residential areas. Experts indicate this approach could be vital in addressing heating demands and reducing carbon footprints.

description: Railways is reviewing the Reservation Against Cancellation (RAC) facility due to passenger discomfort during travel. The existing system charges full fares for shared berths, raising concerns about fairness. Issues arise, particularly when male and female passengers share the same berth space, leading to uncomfortable situations. A parliamentary panel has also recommended the review of this arrangement for better passenger experience.

description: Arnold Swanberg, a Montana-born photographer, donated 480 acres of farmland to the Weissman Hood Institute. The farmland will continue to be leased, and proceeds will support Alzheimer's research in Great Falls, Montana. Swanberg had personal connections to neurodegenerative diseases, influencing his decision to help research in this area. His donation is one of the largest in the institute's history and reflects his commitment to Montana.

description: A retired railway loco pilot is accused of murdering his wife, Pooja Devi, in Bihar's Munger district. Police found her body with a suspected murder weapon at their residence in Jamalpur. The accused allegedly believed Pooja was having an affair, prompting the crime. Her family claims she faced domestic violence and harassment from him for years. The accused has been arrested, and police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a groundbreaking discovery, astronomers have identified two unique gaseous rings encircling the white dwarf star J1328-1450. Utilizing the Very Large Telescope in Chile, researchers explored the surrounding materials, indicating that some smaller planetary bodies likely survived the star's catastrophic end. Unlike previous findings, these rings display varied chemical compositions, shedding light on the planetary conditions that existed prior to the star's demise.
title: Dead star's two rings of shattered planets offer glimpse of Sun's future

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A recent study highlights the vital role of wildlife, particularly birds and bats, in managing pests on cacao farms. These creatures enhance cacao production, especially in areas rich in trees, leading to improved farmer profits. However, for farmers to maximize these benefits, preserving diverse habitats and effectively managing tree growth to ensure adequate light for cacao trees is essential.
title: Birds and bats nearly double cacao harvests on Peruvian farms, study finds

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Focusing too much on one's self-image can significantly influence how a person views their own body and appearance. Research indicates that frequently scrutinizing one’s reflection can result in lower self-esteem and dissatisfaction. While some individuals may develop a heightened awareness of their public image, not every instance of self-gazing indicates insecurity. It's crucial to evaluate how attention to appearance affects personal emotions and behavior in different contexts.
title: Psychology says people who check every mirror may worry how others see them

description: The tenant did not vacate the property. He and his wife had executed a registered settlement deed in favour of their son on August 10, 2001. author: SANJAY SHARMA
description: Astronomers may have solved the mystery behind AT 2016blu, a massive star that has produced at least 27 supernova-like eruptions over 15 years without being destroyed. NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory detected powerful X-ray emissions, pointing to a hidden companion, possibly a black hole or neutron star. Researchers believe the companion periodically captures material from the unstable star, triggering intense bursts of light. The discovery could also shed light on ultra-luminous X-ray sources and stellar evolution.
title: Nasa discovers why a giant star survived 27 explosions without dying

description: Australia captain Pat Cummins responded to Usman Khawaja's claims about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal during a press conference. Cummins stated that Khawaja's allegations were serious and irresponsible, affecting players and their families.
